Loading files for displaying and organizing data.
Loading csv.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
covid <- read_csv("data/ukhsa_chart_download.csv")
gt(covid)
```

```{r}
covid <- read_csv("data/ukhsa_chart_download.csv")
ggplot(covid, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) + 
  geom_line(color = "darkblue") +
  geom_abline(color = "red") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Case Rate per 100k population")
```
